issue.title: Resurface tasks waiting on a reply when the linked Gmail thread gets a new message

task_type_fields.proposal: When a task links a saved mail note and the task is waiting on someone, Gmail history should resurface that task once a new reply arrives in the linked thread (for example a tickler or Next-lane nudge driven by `bob gmail list -r`-style remote counts), so Bryan stops polling his inbox for replies he is waiting on.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Deferred by plan:202611/bob_gmail.md §6 (epic bob-cli-hg): it changes the task-state model, so it needs its own decision record before any implementation, and the Gmail epic deliberately added no task-state triggers (invariant I1: nothing triggers on task completion or reply).

issue.creation_reason: Filed by the bob-cli-hg land agent: plan:202611/bob_gmail.md §6 lists this as a deferred follow-up to file once the Gmail epic lands.

payload.description: Deferred follow-up from the Gmail epic plan §6; builds on what bob-cli-hg shipped
